sectionHeadings: Why a commit, not the tag
7. Deferred — reactive auto-attach on dispatch-cut releases (operator decision)
record.summary: Fix the release-tools workflow_dispatch backfill path: build the CLI tool archives from a commit SHA, never from `refs/tags/$TAG`. A draft release has no git tag yet (drafts don't tag until publish), so deriving the checkout ref from the tag fails `actions/checkout` at a nonexistent ref — making the manual `gh workflow run release-tools.yml -f tag=opc-v0.4.0` backfill unusable for exactly the draft releases it exists to complete. Add an optional `ref` workflow_dispatch input (commit SHA) and default it to the dispatch commit (github.sha); the reactive workflow_run path's head_sha behaviour is unchanged. Coherent SLSA provenance (spec 117) requires the tools build from the same commit as the desktop binaries.
record.title: Release Tools dispatch build-ref — build from a commit, never the (absent) draft tag
